summary: Build ISO 55001 audit skills, prepare for the PECB Lead Auditor exam, and learn to evaluate asset management system conformity.
audienceIntro: ISO 55001 Lead Auditor training suits professionals who evaluate asset management system conformity, lead audits, or prepare an organization for an AMS audit. It is appropriate if you already have a fundamental understanding of asset management concepts and comprehensive knowledge of AMS audit principles.
prerequisites: Participants are required to have a fundamental understanding of asset management concepts and comprehensive knowledge of AMS audit principles.
